# 12-Week Upper-Body Strength Programme
## Client: 29F, Recreational Climber, Right Subacromial Impingement (4 months post-diagnosis)

---

## PROGRAMME OVERVIEW

This programme prioritises scapular stability, posterior chain dominance, and pain-free strength development while respecting the overhead loading restriction. The right shoulder will be managed conservatively with unilateral work to identify and address asymmetries. Climbing-specific pulling patterns are integrated progressively.

**Key Principles:**
- All pressing movements remain below shoulder height
- Scapular control precedes load
- Unilateral work identifies compensation patterns
- Posterior chain emphasis (rhomboids, lower traps, rear delts)
- Progressive climbing-specific pulling
- Pain-free range only; RPE capped at 7/10 for shoulder work

---

## PHASE 1: FOUNDATION & SCAPULAR CONTROL (Weeks 1–4)

**Focus:** Movement quality, bilateral symmetry assessment, scapular activation, pain-free ROM establishment.

**Session Structure:** 3 sessions per week (Mon/Wed/Fri or similar)
- Warm-up: 5–10 min mobility + activation
- Main work: 4–5 exercises
- Finisher: 1–2 accessory/core movements
- Duration: 50–60 minutes

---

### **WEEK 1**

#### **Session 1A: Horizontal Pull & Scapular Stability**

**Warm-up:**
- Arm circles (forward/backward, 10 each direction)
- Band pull-aparts (2×15, light band)
- Dead bugs (2×8 each side)
- Cat-cow (10 reps)

**Main Work:**

1. **Prone Y-T-W Raises** (scapular activation)
   - 3×8 each position (Y, T, W)
   - Bodyweight, slow 3-second eccentric
   - Focus: scapular retraction, no shoulder hiking
   - *Cue: "Lead with your elbows, not your hands"*

2. **Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row** (bilateral)
   - 4×8 @ RPE 5
   - Incline bench, 30° angle
   - Dumbbells 8–12 kg (light)
   - Pause 1 second at chest
   - *Cue: "Squeeze shoulder blades together; elbows stay close"*

3. **Half-Kneeling Pallof Press** (anti-rotation core)
   - 3×8 each side @ RPE 4
   - Cable or band, light resistance
   - Tall posture, no trunk rotation
   - *Cue: "Brace your core; press straight ahead"*

4. **Inverted Row (Feet Elevated)** (horizontal pull, scapular control)
   - 3×6 @ RPE 5
   - Bar at chest height, feet on low box
   - Full scapular retraction at top
   - *Cue: "Pull chest to bar; hold 1 second"*

**Finisher:**
- Quadruped shoulder taps (3×10 each side)
- Plank hold (3×20 seconds)

---

#### **Session 1B: Lower-Body Strength & Unilateral Stability**

*Note: Lower-body work supports overall stability and allows upper-body recovery.*

1. **Goblet Squat**
   - 4×8 @ RPE 6
   - 12–16 kg kettlebell
   - Full depth, chest upright

2. **Single-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)**
   - 3×6 each leg @ RPE 5
   - Light dumbbell (4–6 kg)
   - Focus on balance and hip hinge

3. **Sled Push** (or leg press)
   - 3×8 @ RPE 6
   - Moderate load

4. **Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze**
   - 3×12 each side

---

#### **Session 1C: Vertical Pull & Shoulder Health**

1. **Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)** (vertical pull, pain-free)
   - 4×8 @ RPE 5
   - Light weight (15–20 kg)
   - Elbows slightly in front of shoulders
   - *Cue: "Pull elbows down and back; chest up"*

2. **Dumbbell Single-Arm Row** (unilateral assessment)
   - 3×8 each arm @ RPE 5
   - 8–10 kg
   - Tall kneeling or half-kneeling
   - *Cue: "Row to hip; no trunk rotation"*

3. **Landmine Press** (low-angle pressing)
   - 3×8 @ RPE 4
   - Light load (5–10 kg total)
   - 45° angle, pressing at chest height
   - *Cue: "Press straight; no flare"*

4. **Prone Incline Dumbbell Curl** (elbow flexion, shoulder-friendly)
   - 3×10 @ RPE 5
   - 6–8 kg dumbbells
   - Incline bench, 45°

**Finisher:**
- Scapular wall slides (3×10)
- Prone cobra hold (3×15 seconds)

---

### **WEEK 2**

Repeat Week 1 structure with **+1 rep per set** on main compound movements (rows, pulldowns, presses). Maintain RPE ≤6. Assess right shoulder symmetry during unilateral work; note any compensation.

---

### **WEEK 3**

**Progression:** Increase load by 5–10% on main movements; maintain rep ranges. Introduce **tempo work** on rows (3-second eccentric).

#### **Session 3A: Horizontal Pull & Scapular Stability**

1. **Prone Y-T-W Raises**
   - 3×10 each position (increased reps)

2. **Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row**
   - 4×8 @ RPE 5–6
   - 10–14 kg (increased load)
   - 3-second eccentric

3. **Half-Kneeling Pallof Press**
   - 3×10 each side @ RPE 5

4. **Inverted Row (Feet Elevated)**
   - 3×8 @ RPE 6
   - Increased difficulty: feet higher or body angle steeper

**Finisher:**
- Quadruped shoulder taps (3×12 each side)
- Plank hold (3×30 seconds)

---

#### **Session 3B: Lower-Body Strength**

1. **Goblet Squat**
   - 4×8 @ RPE 6–7
   - 14–18 kg

2. **Single-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)**
   - 3×8 each leg @ RPE 6
   - 6–8 kg

3. **Sled Push**
   - 3×10 @ RPE 6–7

4. **Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze**
   - 3×15 each side

---

#### **Session 3C: Vertical Pull & Shoulder Health**

1. **Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)**
   - 4×8 @ RPE 6
   - 18–24 kg (increased load)
   - 3-second eccentric

2. **Dumbbell Single-Arm Row**
   - 3×10 each arm @ RPE 6
   - 10–12 kg

3. **Landmine Press**
   - 3×10 @ RPE 5
   - 8–12 kg total

4. **Prone Incline Dumbbell Curl**
   - 3×12 @ RPE 6
   - 8–10 kg

**Finisher:**
- Scapular wall slides (3×12)
- Prone cobra hold (3×20 seconds)

---

### **WEEK 4: DELOAD & ASSESSMENT**

Reduce volume by 40%; maintain movement quality. Use this week to assess progress and identify any asymmetries or pain patterns.

#### **Session 4A: Horizontal Pull & Scapular Stability**

1. **Prone Y-T-W Raises**
   - 2×8 each position

2. **Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row**
   - 3×6 @ RPE 4
   - Same load as Week 3

3. **Half-Kneeling Pallof Press**
   - 2×8 each side @ RPE 4

4. **Inverted Row (Feet Elevated)**
   - 2×6 @ RPE 4

**Finisher:**
- Quadruped shoulder taps (2×10 each side)
- Plank hold (2×20 seconds)

---

#### **Session 4B: Lower-Body Strength**

1. **Goblet Squat**
   - 3×6 @ RPE 5

2. **Single-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)**
   - 2×6 each leg @ RPE 4

3. **Sled Push**
   - 2×8 @ RPE 5

4. **Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze**
   - 2×12 each side

---

#### **Session 4C: Vertical Pull & Shoulder Health**

1. **Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)**
   - 3×6 @ RPE 4

2. **Dumbbell Single-Arm Row**
   - 2×8 each arm @ RPE 4

3. **Landmine Press**
   - 2×8 @ RPE 4

4. **Prone Incline Dumbbell Curl**
   - 2×10 @ RPE 4

**Finisher:**
- Scapular wall slides (2×10)
- Prone cobra hold (2×15 seconds)

---

## PHASE 2: STRENGTH DEVELOPMENT & CLIMBING INTEGRATION (Weeks 5–8)

**Focus:** Progressive load, climbing-specific pulling patterns, unilateral strength asymmetry correction, scapular endurance.

**Session Structure:** 3 sessions per week
- Warm-up: 8–10 min mobility + activation
- Main work: 5–6 exercises
- Finisher: 1–2 accessory/core movements
- Duration: 60–70 minutes

---

### **WEEK 5**

#### **Session 5A: Horizontal Pull & Climbing Prep**

**Warm-up:**
- Band pull-aparts (2×15)
- Scapular wall slides (2×10)
- Dead bugs (2×8 each side)
- Arm circles (10 each direction)

**Main Work:**

1. **Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row** (bilateral strength)
   - 4×6 @ RPE 6–7
   - 12–16 kg
   - 3-second eccentric, 1-second pause

2. **Single-Arm Dumbbell Row (Half-Kneeling)** (unilateral, climbing-specific)
   - 4×6 each arm @ RPE 6
   - 10–14 kg
   - Tall posture, no trunk rotation
   - *Cue: "Row to hip; feel lat engagement"*

3. **Inverted Row (Feet Elevated)** (horizontal pull endurance)
   - 3×8 @ RPE 6–7
   - Steeper angle than Phase 1

4. **Landmine Press** (low-angle pressing strength)
   - 3×8 @ RPE 5–6
   - 10–14 kg total
   - Controlled tempo

5. **Prone Y-T-W Raises** (scapular endurance)
   - 3×10 each position @ RPE 4
   - Bodyweight

**Finisher:**
- Quadruped shoulder taps (3×12 each side)
- Plank hold (3×30 seconds)

---

#### **Session 5B: Lower-Body Strength & Power**

1. **Back Squat** (or Goblet Squat progression)
   - 4×6 @ RPE 6–7
   - Moderate load

2. **Single-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)**
   - 3×8 each leg @ RPE 6
   - 8–10 kg

3. **Sled Push**
   - 3×10 @ RPE 6–7

4. **Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze**
   - 3×15 each side

---

#### **Session 5C: Vertical Pull & Shoulder Strength**

1. **Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)** (vertical pull strength)
   - 4×6 @ RPE 6–7
   - 24–30 kg
   - 3-second eccentric

2. **Assisted Pull-Up (Negative Emphasis)** (climbing-specific, if pain-free)
   - 4×3–5 @ RPE 6
   - Band assistance or machine

**Goal:** Establish baseline hanging tolerance, assess right shoulder stability

**Session Frequency:** 1x/week (Friday, after Stair Climber cardio)
**Duration:** 10–15 minutes total

**Warm-up (5 min):**
- Arm circles (10 each direction)
- Band pull-aparts (2×15)
- Scapular wall slides (2×10)
- Dead hangs (2×10 seconds, light grip)

**Main Work:**

1. **Dead Hang (Bilateral, Full Grip)**
   - 4 × 10–15 seconds @ RPE 3–4
   - Full grip (all fingers engaged)
   - Scapulae retracted, shoulders packed
   - Rest: 30 seconds between sets
   - *Cue: "Hang from your shoulders, not your fingers; pack your scapulae"*
   - **Monitor:** Right shoulder pain/discomfort; stop if present

   - 3 × 5–8 seconds @ RPE 4

   - Assess right shoulder stability
   - Rest: 60 seconds between sets

   - **If pain: skip; return to bilateral hangs**

   - Right hand on pull-up bar for 50% support
   - Baseline comparison (left should be stronger)
   - Rest: 60 seconds between sets

**Finisher (2 min):**
- Scapular wall slides (2×10)
- Prone cobra hold (1×20 seconds)

## MOBILITY ASSESSMENT & PROGRESSION

### **Weekly Mobility Check-In**

**Timing:** End of each week (Friday or Sunday)
**Duration:** 5 minutes
**Focus:** Assess mobility improvements, identify restrictions

#### **Assessment Protocol:**

1. **Right Shoulder ROM (Overhead Reach)**
   - Stand, raise right arm overhead
   - Rate ROM: 1–10 (1 = very restricted, 10 = full ROM)
   - Note any pain/discomfort

2. **Right Shoulder ROM (Internal Rotation)**
   - Supine, right arm at 90°, elbow bent
   - Gently press right hand toward floor
   - Rate ROM: 1–10
   - Note any pain/discomfort

3. **Thoracic Spine Extension**
   - Supine, foam roller under mid-back
   - Gently extend thoracic spine
   - Rate ROM: 1–10
   - Note any restriction

4. **Hip Mobility (Pigeon Pose)**
   - Right leg forward, left leg extended back
   - Rate ROM: 1–10
   - Note any restriction

5. **Ankle Mobility (Deep Squat)**
   - Feet shoulder-width apart, squat deep
   - Rate ROM: 1–10
   - Note any restriction

#### **Progression Criteria:**

- **ROM Improvement:** +1–2 points per week (expected)
- **Pain Reduction:** Decrease in pain/discomfort (expected)
- **Climbing Performance:** Improved movement quality, footwork (expected)

#### **Adjustment Protocol:**

- **If ROM plateaus:** Increase dedicated mobility session frequency (2x/week)
- **If pain increases:** Reduce intensity, consult physio
- **If ROM improves significantly:** Progress to advanced stretches (deeper holds, PNF stretching)

**Client:** 29F, recreational climber, right subacromial impingement (4 months post-diagnosis)
